HIEROPHANT2-HALLOWED_STIPEND.title: Hallowed Stipend
HIEROPHANT2-HALLOWED_STIPEND.description: The first time you lose gold each combat, lose [green]5[/green] less.
HIEROPHANT2-HALLOWED_STIPEND.flavor: A faithful servant is expected to primarily fund their own mission.
HIEROPHANT2-CONSECRATED_STIPEND.title: Consecrated Stipend
HIEROPHANT2-CONSECRATED_STIPEND.descript: The first three times you lose gold each combat, lose [green]8[/green] less.
HIEROPHANT2-CONSECRATED_STIPEND.flavor: A true servant may receive greater funding for their mission.
